headline: This law requires the VA to raise several veterans' and survivors' benefit payments by the same percentage as Social Security benefits starting December 1, 2016.
what_it_does: It directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to increase disability compensation, extra payments for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. The increase uses the same percentage as the cost-of-living increase for Social Security (OASDI) benefits, effective on the same date. The VA must also publish the new amounts in the Federal Register by the deadline set for Social Security increases in fiscal year 2017.

who_it_affects.how: Their monthly disability payments increase by the same percentage as Social Security benefits beginning December 1, 2016.
The extra amounts paid for spouses, children, and other dependents also increase by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Certain disabled veterans who receive the clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: Their clothing allowance amount increases by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses and children receiving dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their survivor payments increase by the same percentage as Social Security benefits.

when_it_takes_effect: The increases take effect December 1, 2016, and the VA must publish the new amounts in the Federal Register by the FY2017 deadline for Social Security increases.
